description: Header file defining RAII classes DeviceGuard and OptionalDeviceGuard for managing device context in PyTorch, including methods for setting, resetting, and querying devices, with detailed documentation and implementation details.

classes.name: DeviceGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that sets a specific device upon construction and resets it upon destruction, ensuring device context management.

classes.name: OptionalDeviceGuard
classes.description: An optional RAII device guard that may be uninitialized, providing flexible device context management with optional semantics.

methods.name: reset_device
methods.description: Sets the device to the specified device, with an overload for testing that accepts an implementation interface.

methods.name: set_index
methods.description: Sets the device index inferred from the original device type.

methods.name: original_device
methods.description: Returns the device that was active at the time of guard construction.

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Returns the most recent device set by the guard, either from construction or via reset.
